newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bearish sentiment grips Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bearish sentiment grips Bucharest bourse.

text.p: Increased local leu currency volatility with foreign exchange market liberalisation affected Bucharest bourse trading on Thursday when most prices and turnover fell.
"All foreign investors were in wait-and-see mood due to the firmer leu currency which made stocks prices too expensive," one broker said.
Investors awaited a stabilisation of the leu to invest again in the bourse, he adeed.
Turnover fell on Thursday to 1.46 billion lei from 2.59 billion in the previous session.
First-tier Azomures SA fertiliser maker and Oltchim SA chemical plant took the bulk of the trading, or over 96 percent of the total turnover.
Oltchim ended 200 lei weaker at 1,500 lei, while Azomures gained 10 lei to close at 1,530.
Traders expect fresh lows on Oltchim and Azomures stocks due to thin demand and expectations of selling presure.
Of the 25 listings on the Bucharest bourse, five rose, 12 fell and eight had no trades.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- fell both by 13.5 from the previous session.
